semantics: Effective high-path bar is 100% (0 survivors dominates). kill_ratio is informative-only and cannot pass a high-path survivor; a single survivor on a changed high-path line fails even when score >= threshold. This unifies the former contradictory ratio comfort with the max_survivors_in_high_path=0 bar.

fail_closed.note: Missing score, threshold, or 0 mutants must not PASS via 0<0. The gate_run checker owned by another agent must emit MUTATION_MISSING_SCORE / MUTATION_MISSING_THRESHOLD / MUTATION_NO_MUTANTS findings; see gate_run_patch_pending.

cap_enforcement.rule: Require total_mutatable == total_generated or FAIL with finding mutants_truncated (MUTATION_TRUNCATED). Truncation at the cap must never silently pass.
cap_enforcement.reason: No mutate-run generator lives in this harness (only gate_run.check_mutation scores fixture score/threshold/survivors; it does not generate or count mutants), so the cap cannot be enforced from policy alone.
cap_enforcement.gate_run_patch_pending: In files/tools/gate_run.py check_mutation: if data.get('total_mutatable') is not None and data.get('total_generated') is not None and data['total_mutatable'] != data['total_generated']: findings.append(finding('MUTATION_TRUNCATED','mutants_truncated',f"total_mutatable {data['total_mutatable']} != total_generated {data['total_generated']} (cap {policy.max_mutants_per_hunk})")); also treat missing score/threshold as BLOCK with MUTATION_MISSING_SCORE / MUTATION_MISSING_THRESHOLD and mutants==0 as MUTATION_NO_MUTANTS. Patch text is provided for the gate_run owner; it is not applied here because gate_run.py is owned by another agent.
